name: ez-core
description: Core working skills: wdyr (researched recommendations), auto-run (work without stopping), ccf (group changed files into commits), check-code (DRY, SSOT and best-practice audit), short-message (plain-text message to send)

research_dir.title: wdyr research folder
research_dir.description: Folder where wdyr saves each recommendation's research. Leave empty to save only when your instructions name a folder.

org_repo.title: ccf org repo
org_repo.description: Repo that `ccf org` uses. Leave empty if you have none.

project_dirs.title: ccf project folders
project_dirs.description: Comma-separated folders that hold project repos, so `ccf <project>` finds <folder>/<project>.

daily_logs.title: ccf daily logs
daily_logs.description: Comma-separated globs with YYYYMMDD (e.g. time/YYYYMMDD.md). Today's file is left out of commits; earlier days are grouped.

coding_guides.title: check-code shared coding guides
coding_guides.description: Comma-separated folders of coding guides that check-code reads besides the repo's own rules. Leave empty to use only the repo's rules and official sources.

audit_dir.title: check-code audit folder
audit_dir.description: Folder where check-code writes audit files; <project> stands for the repo's folder name (e.g. /work/org/<project>/tasks/audits). Leave empty to write no audit files.

plain_letters.title: short-message plain letters
plain_letters.description: Write messages without diacritics (Romanian a, s, t instead of ă, ș, ț). Leave off to spell each language normally.
